hack.root_cause: Reentrancy — Missing Guards on collectFees / Withdrawal Function
hack.description: GemPad's LP lock contract — the mechanism that was supposed to secure other projects' liquidity — had no reentrancy guard on its withdrawal function, letting an attacker drain ~$1.9M across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Base using malicious token callbacks.
